Agent Name: Coder
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Coder agent made the first critical error in Step 1 by incorrectly identifying the Latin root of the Yola word "gimlie" as "gemma" (gem/bud) and assuming it shares a spelling with the Spanish word "gema." This etymological assumption is flawed; "gimlie" is not derived from "gemma." Because this foundational fact was wrong, all subsequent steps (searching for "gema" in the Collins dictionary, looking for 1994 examples, and eventually guessing the title "Cien años de soledad" based on that incorrect word) were based on a false premise, leading to the wrong solution.
